verdict_text:
NO

The regex `matrix_re` only matches `query_key_value.weight`, `dense_h_to_4h.weight`, and `dense_4h_to_h.weight` — it omits `attention.dense.weight`, so only 48 of the 64 required projection matrices are cast to bfloat16, violating Required Result clause 1 (which mandates exactly 64 matrices cast). The script's own check asserts `== 48` bfloat16 tensors instead of 64, silently encoding the wrong count rather than the required check "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16." As a result `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` is incorrectly left in float32 in the output.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
